svg.text: Why a Vectrex draws round corners
The game stops the integrators at the corner, waits, then sends them the new way. The spot follows them about 13 cycles late.
still on its way: cuts the corner
arrives and waits: sharp, a bright dot
where the integrators are: the path an ordinary emulator draws - always a sharp corner
where the spot really is (the beam lit all the way): brighter where it lingers
Legs of 25 cycles at speed $50, X turning round, Y going on (the Corner Test). The spot: three equal lag stages, 13.3 cycles in all,
as measured on a real Vectrex and used by the emulator (simplified: the RAMP delays left out). One cycle = 2/3 microsecond.
